channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Entenda o que é a 'taxa das blusinhas' e o vaivém do imposto
item.description: President Lula (PT) signed a provisional measure that eliminates the federal tax on international purchases up to US$50, popularly known as the 'blusinhas tax'. The announcement was made at the Planalto Palace after internal government debate and comes months ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula zera 'taxa das blusinhas'; compras da China até U$$ 50 não serão mais taxadas
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a Provisional Measure eliminating the 20% Import Tax on international purchases up to US$ 50, commonly known as the 'tax on small packages'. The measure aims to lower the cost of imported consumer goods for individuals and boost low-value cross-border e-commerce.

item.title: Kassio Nunes Marques assina termo de posse como presidente do TSE
item.description: Ministers Kassio Nunes Marques and André Mendonça signed the terms of office as president and vice-president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), respectively. The ceremony took place on Wednesday, marking the beginning of their leadership of the Electoral Justice for the 2025-2027 biennium. The appointment reinforces the independence and impartiality of the TSE ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Começa cerimônia de posse de Kássio Nunes Marques na presidência do TSE
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) began on Tuesday night, the 12th, the swearing-in ceremony of Minister Kássio Nunes Marques as president and André Mendonça as vice-president of the Court. The solemnity marks the start of their mandates in the presidency and vice-presidency of the TSE for the 2025-2026 biennium.

item.title: Nunes Marques é empossado como presidente do TSE
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques was sworn in as the new president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), replacing Minister Cármen Lúcia, with André Mendonça as vice-president. The ceremony took place on Tuesday, the 12th, and the article is being updated.

item.title: Bia Kicis diz que Lula age por eleição ao rever “taxação das blusinhas”
item.description: Federal Deputy Bia Kicis (PL-DF) accused President Lula of acting with electoral motives by abolishing the so-called "blusinhas tax", which removes the 20% import duty on international online purchases up to US$ 50. She claimed the move was designed to please voters in an election year, disregarding fiscal consequences and harm to domestic industry.

item.title: “I love you”: o telefonema entre Trump e Lula pelo celular de Joesley
item.description: President Lula secured a visit to Washington through a phone call with Donald Trump made via the cellphone of businessman Joesley Batista. The call took place at the Palácio da Alvorada on the eve of the May 1 holiday, after Lula mentioned difficulties in scheduling an in-person meeting with the U.S. president.

item.title: “Tinha que ter eleição todo mês”, diz Flávio sobre fim da taxa das blusinhas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the revocation of the 20% import tax on international purchases up to US$ 50 (known as the 'blusinhas tax'), stating that 'there should be an election every month' because of the measure. He called the Lula government's decision harmful to trade and consumers, advocating for the tariff's maintenance as a way to protect national industry.

item.title: Após reunião com Moraes, relator de Lei da Dosimetria diz estar ‘confiante’ que texto terá validade
item.description: Paulinho da Força, rapporteur of the Dosimetry Law, expressed confidence in the law's validity after meeting with Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, expecting a ruling in late May. The law, which reduces sentences for those convicted of the January 8 attacks and benefits Jair Bolsonaro, had its application suspended by Moraes pending review of two ADIs challenging its constitutionality.

item.title: ‘Taxa das blusinhas’ era acertada, mas impopular. Em ano eleitoral, Lula recuou
item.description: The 'Blusinhas Tax,' introduced in 2024 to levy duties on low-value international purchases under $50, was deemed a sound policy to correct e-commerce distortions, but was abandoned by Lula in an election year due to its unpopularity. The government replaced it with the Remessa Conforme system, preserving enforcement goals while avoiding political backlash.

item.title: PT se reúne com Pacheco, mas aliança em MG segue aberta
item.description: The PT met with Senator Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB-MG) to discuss his potential candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais in 2026, but negotiations remain open. PT president Edinho Silva said the party still needs to consult its Minas Gerais base and that Pacheco is not satisfied with just the party's blessing, demanding political structure and proper timing. Lula views Pacheco as the ideal candidate and has no 'plan B', while Pacheco sees a TCU appointment as a 'career end', preferring the visibility of running for state executive.

item.title: Caiado chama Lula de ‘cara de pau’ por criar plano contra crime próximo da eleição
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) accused President Lula of being 'shameless' for launching a plan to combat organized crime only five months before the 2026 elections, arguing it should have been implemented from the start of his administration. Caiado criticized the plan for allocating one billion reais from the federal budget and ten billion reais in BNDES credit lines, claiming it would indebt states and municipalities to pay high interest, constituting a form of 'loan-sharking' by the federal government.

item.title: Nunes Marques toma posse como presidente do TSE com presença Lula, Flávio e cúpula do Congresso
item.description: Kássio Nunes Marques was sworn in as president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) in a ceremony attended by Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and authorities from the Three Powers. The event marked the first public meeting between Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre since the Senate rejected Jorge Messias’ STF nomination. Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the TSE’s conduct in the 2022 elections, called for neutrality in 2026, and said he would greet Lula if they crossed paths.

item.title: Lula agiu agora para não perder bandeira de redução da 'taxa das blusinhas' para oposição
item.description: Lula signed a provisional measure eliminating the 20% import tax on purchases up to $50, aiming to retain ownership of the 'tax on small packages' issue amid opposition advances. The move comes despite internal resistance from retailers and industry, including Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, and seeks to prevent the opposition from co-opting the policy narrative.

item.title: La UE prohibirá la importación de carne desde Brasil a partir de septiembre
item.description: The European Union will ban the import of Brazilian meat and other animal-origin products for human consumption starting September 3, citing Brazil's failure to meet rules requiring products to be free of antimicrobials used for growth promotion. The government of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said it will present its arguments in Brussels on Wednesday to reverse the measure, which is part of the EU's efforts to reduce antibiotic resistance.

item.title: Nunes Marques e André Mendonça assumem comando do TSE com Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro na posse
item.description: Kassio Nunes Marques assumed the presidency of the TSE with André Mendonça as vice-president, in a ceremony marked by the presence of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, both candidates for re-election in 2026. The event also featured Michelle Bolsonaro, Viviane Barci, and Yara de Abreu, alongside political and judicial authorities. Nunes Marques and Mendonça, appointed by Jair Bolsonaro, will oversee the 2026 elections, focusing on combating misinformation and AI-generated content.

item.title: Pressão, desgaste e recuos: a trajetória da taxa das blusinhas no governo Lula
item.description: The Lula government abolished the 'blusinhas tax,' a 20% federal levy on international purchases under $50, after nearly three years of pressure from domestic retailers, lobbying by Asian e-commerce giants, and public backlash. Initially introduced to counter unfair competition, the tax was widely criticized on social media as a burden on low-income consumers, prompting a partial retreat and eventual full repeal. The policy's reversal highlights the tension between protecting local industry, fiscal revenue, and maintaining affordable access to imported goods in the era of global e-commerce.

item.title: MPT abre investigação contra Zema por ‘apologia ao trabalho infantil’
item.description: The Labor Public Ministry opened an investigation against Romeu Zema for alleged apology of child labor, after he proposed in an interview to allow children to work in Brazil if elected. The complaint was filed by the Mixed Parliamentary Front for Combating Child Labor, which claims his statements signal a political project to dismantle decades of civilizational progress and violate constitutional petrified clauses. Zema initially used the term 'child' but later changed it to 'adolescent' in a follow-up video, maintaining his stance.

item.title: Acompanhe, ao vivo, a posse do ministro Nunes Marques na Presidência do TSE
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques was sworn in as president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on Tuesday, March 12, at 7 p.m., in a ceremony held in the court's plenary in Brasília. In the same session, Minister André Mendonça assumed the vice-presidency of the court. Under his leadership, the TSE will oversee the 2026 General Elections, focusing on electronic ballot security, countering disinformation, and strengthening public trust in Brazil's electoral system.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre se encontram pela 1ª vez em posse no TSE depois de derrota de Messias ao STF
item.description: President Lula and Senator Alcolumbre met publicly for the first time at the swearing-in of Minister Kassio Nunes Marques at the TSE, following the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF. The meeting took place amid tension, as Lula's allies accuse Alcolumbre of orchestrating Messias' defeat, which he denies. The situation reveals fractures in the government's base, with divisions over how the administration should respond to the Senate's rebuke.

item.title: Nunes Marques assume presidência do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral
item.description: Kassio Nunes Marques assumed the presidency of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on Tuesday (12), succeeding Minister Cármen Lúcia and taking command of the Electoral Court for the October 2026 elections. He was elected to the position in April and will serve until May 2027. The ceremony was attended by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Senate and Chamber presidents, and other STF ministers.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro rejeita aliança com grupo de Zema em Minas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) rejected a potential alliance between the PL and the political group of former governor Romeu Zema (Novo) in Minas Gerais. The decision was made following a meeting in Brasília with campaign coordinator Rogério Marinho and the PL state president in Minas, Zé Vitor, among others. For now, no agreement has been reached between the parties.

item.title: Lula: governo criará Ministério da Segurança apenas com aprovação de PEC pelo Senado
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced that the government will create the Ministry of Public Security only if the Senate approves the Security PEC. The statement was made during the launch of the 'Brazil against organized crime' program, which allocates 11 billion reais for public security.

item.title: Entidade questiona arquivamento de denúncia contra Flávio Bolsonaro por evento em igreja
item.description: The Secular Brazil Movement filed an appeal against the dismissal of a complaint against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for alleged premature electioneering during a religious event at the Assembleia de Deus Belém church. The group claims religious and economic abuse of power, arguing that religious leaders exerted direct influence over a spiritually vulnerable audience to promote the senator and mobilize evangelical voters. It requests the reopening of the investigation and the application of appropriate electoral measures.

item.title: Mesmo com fim da 'taxa das blusinhas', ICMS sobre compras internacionais continua em vigor; entenda
item.description: The federal government has eliminated the 20% import tax on international purchases up to US$50, known as the 'blusinhas tax,' but the state-level ICMS tax remains in effect, ranging from 17% to 20% in most states under a Conselhos Fazendários agreement. Only Amapá and Pará opted out of the agreement and maintain different rates. For purchases above US$50, the 60% federal import tax still applies.

item.title: Senado aprova renovação automática da CNH para motoristas sem multas
item.description: The Senate approved automatic renewal of the National Driver's License (CNH) for drivers with no traffic violations in the past 12 months, applicable to those under 50 and allowing one-time renewal for drivers aged 50–69, subject to registration in the Rnpc. The measure now awaits presidential sanction, retains physical and mental exam requirements, and allows drivers to choose between physical or digital license formats.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que não recusaria cumprimentar Lula: 'Se passar perto, não tenho problema'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president in 2026, stated he would not refuse to greet President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) if they crossed paths during the ceremony for Minister Kassio Nunes Marques assuming the presidency of the TSE. He emphasized he has no issue with greeting the president should they happen to be near each other.

item.title: Ancelotti diz que decisão sobre Neymar será "100% profissional" e baseada apenas em desempenho
item.description: Coach Carlo Ancelotti stated that the decision to include Neymar in Brazil's 2026 World Cup squad will be based solely on the player's on-field performance, without external pressure. He acknowledged Neymar's talent and the affection he inspires among teammates, but emphasized that the final call is his alone and will not be swayed by public opinion or emotional factors.

item.title: Lula assina medida provisória para zerar "taxa das blusinhas"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a provisional measure to eliminate federal taxation on imported goods valued at up to US$ 50, commonly referred to as the 'blusinhas tax'. The policy aims to lower the cost of goods purchased from international e-commerce platforms and responds to public demand for tax exemptions on low-value imports.

item.title: Lula anuncia o fim da 'taxa das blusinhas': veja como foi a queda de braço no governo para isentar importados de até US$ 50
item.description: President Lula announced the end of the 'little shirts tax', eliminating the import duty on goods up to US$50, following an internal government struggle. The move, pushed by the political faction to boost Lula’s popularity ahead of the 2026 election, overcame resistance from economic ministries and was backed by the Chief of Staff, Communications, and Institutional Relations ministers. The ICMS on international purchases remains in effect.

item.title: PL quer definir palanque de Flavio em Minas em até 15 dias
item.description: The PL aims to finalize Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign slate in Minas Gerais within 15 days, with an event scheduled for June 1. Senator Cleitinho (Republicanos) is expected to lead the party’s ticket in the state. PL president Valdemar Costa Neto met earlier today with Cleitinho and Flávio to align campaign details.

item.title: Lula assina MP para zerar a ‘taxa das blusinhas’
item.description: President Lula signed a provisional measure eliminating the 20% federal tax on international purchases under $50, known as the 'blusinhas tax'. The change, announced by Chief of Staff Minister Miriam Belchior, takes effect immediately. The move responds to the tax's unpopularity, which was identified as the government's main mistake in an AtlasIntel poll.

item.title: Relator conversa com Moraes e espera dosimetria no STF ainda em maio. Veja vídeo
item.description: Paulinho da Força, the rapporteur of the Dosimetria bill, met with Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to discuss the suspension of the law promulgated by Davi Alcolumbre. He described the meeting as positive and expects the STF to rule on the dosimetria issue in the last week of May, once the institutions respond to the minister’s requests.

item.title: Temer compara economia atual a 2016 e cita inflação e juros altos
item.description: Former President Michel Temer compared Brazil's current economy to the situation in 2016, citing high inflation and interest rates, while urging optimism and institutional reforms. He proposed a 'republican pact' among the three branches of government and civil society to drive national development, advocating for election campaigns based on detailed written projects of 20–30 pages. Temer spoke at the Lide Brazil Investment Forum in New York, discussing presidential succession with candidates including Romeu Zema, Ronaldo Caiado, and Augusto Cury.

item.title: ‘Espero neutralidade, nada além disso’, diz Flávio Bolsonaro sobre TSE sob comando de Nunes Marques
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, attended the swearing-in of Kassio Nunes Marques as president of the TSE and called for electoral neutrality in 2026, criticizing Alexandre de Moraes’ leadership for 'unbalancing' the 2022 race. He said he would have no issue greeting Lula if they crossed paths and stated that the primary goal is to overturn Jair Bolsonaro’s criminal conviction in the STF, which he called a farce, before addressing his ineligibility.

item.title: Flávio diz esperar 'neutralidade' do TSE em posse de Nunes Marques como presidente da Corte
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) said he expects 'neutrality' from the TSE during the 2026 elections under the presidency of Minister Nunes Marques. He criticized the tribunal's conduct in 2022, when led by Alexandre de Moraes, calling it 'lamentable' and alleging that the then-president unbalanced the electoral race.

item.title: O que é a 'taxa das blusinhas', que Lula cancelou após quase dois anos?
item.description: President Lula has canceled the 'little shirts tax', a 20% import duty on international shipments under US$ 50, which had been in effect since August 2024. The measure, announced on Tuesday (12) and effective Wednesday, removes the import tax on such purchases, reversing a policy that generated record revenue of R$ 1.78 billion in the first four months of 2026. The change was enacted via a Provisional Measure to be published in the Official Gazette, following internal and external pressure, despite initial support from domestic industry.

item.title: Lula assina MP e zera imposto federal sobre a "taxa das blusinhas"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a Provisional Measure eliminating the federal tax on international purchases under US$50, known as the 'blusinhas tax', effective immediately. The move aims to reduce tax burden on popular consumption, responding to criticism that the tax disproportionately affected low-income groups. While the industrial sector supports the tax for protecting jobs and domestic production, polls show 62% of Brazilians view it as a mistake, increasing pressure on the government to reverse the policy.

item.title: “Medida eleitoreira”, diz líder da oposição ao comentar pressa do governo para redução da escala 6×1
item.description: The opposition leader in the Chamber of Deputies, Cabo Gilberto Silva (PL-PB), accused the Lula government of adopting an 'electoral measure' by pushing for the immediate reduction of the 6×1 work scale after possible congressional approval. He reacted to statements by Labor Minister Luiz Marinho, claiming the government's haste is aimed at electoral gain, not a structured labor reform.

item.title: Lula diz que criará Ministério da Segurança se PEC for aprovada
item.description: President Lula announced he will create the Ministry of Public Security if the PEC on the topic is approved by the Senate. The proposal, pending in the Senate since March, aims to secure permanent funding for the Brazil Against Organized Crime Program, including BNDES financing and allocations from betting revenues and pre-salt surplus. The program, launched with R$11.1 billion, depends on the PEC to ensure budgetary continuity.

item.title: Lula anuncia fim da taxa das blusinhas; compras internacionais de até US$ 50 não pagarão imposto
item.description: The Lula government announced the end of the 20% import tax on international purchases up to US$ 50, known as the 'blusinhas tax', to be formalized via a Provisional Measure and take effect after publication in the Official Gazette. The move, made less than five months before the 2026 elections, represents a fiscal renunciation, as the government had collected R$ 1.78 billion from this tax in the first four months of 2026.

item.title: Oposição pede impeachment contra Moraes por suspensão da lei da redução de penas
item.description: Opposition leader Cabo Gilberto Silva (PL-PB) filed an impeachment request against Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes for suspending the sentencing reduction law that lowers penalties for those convicted of coup-related acts, such as in the case of Débora do batom. The request was made on Tuesday, May 12, 2026.

item.title: A cinco meses das eleições, Lula anuncia fim da 'taxa das blusinhas', cobrança de 20% sobre compras internacionais
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced the end of the 'blusinhas tax', a 20% import duty on international purchases up to US$ 50, through a provisional measure and a Ministry of Finance ordinance. The change, effective Wednesday, keeps ICMS in place but removes the import tax on low-value consumer goods, aiming to ease the burden on lower-income populations. Revenue from the tax reached R$ 1.78 billion in the first four months of 2026, up 25% year-on-year.

item.title: Universidade “não pode ser espaço de baderna”, diz Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas praised the police operation that removed students from the USP rectorate, stating that 'the police acted as they should have'. He emphasized that while universities are open spaces for debate and knowledge, they cannot become sites of disorder, underscoring the need for order in academic environments.

item.title: Projeto destina recursos para a compra de imóveis por órgãos do Judiciário
item.description: The National Congress is analyzing a bill that allocates R$4.2 million from the 2026 budget for the acquisition of properties by the Electoral Regional Court of Alagoas and the Regional Labor Court of Paraná. The TRE/AL aims to purchase a property near its current headquarters to reduce costs from dispersed leases, while the TRT/PR seeks to expand its facilities. The project will be reviewed by the Joint Budget Committee before moving to the Congressional plenary.

item.title: Relator da lei da dosimetria posta foto com Moraes após reunião e diz estar 'otimista' sobre validade do texto
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes met with Deputy Paulinho da Força, rapporteur of the Dosimetry Law, which reduces penalties for those involved in coup acts and benefits former President Jair Bolsonaro. After the meeting, Paulinho expressed optimism about the law’s validity and said Moraes indicated the STF judgment could happen in the last week of May. Moraes had previously issued a preliminary injunction suspending the law’s effects, drawing criticism from Bolsonarist figures like Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who alleged improper proximity between the minister and the rapporteur.

item.title: Lula e Trump, PL da Dosimetria: o que movimentou as redes na última semana
item.description: The meeting between Lula and Trump was the most discussed topic on social media last week, with 44% of posts coming from the far-right, which accused the Brazilian president of giving away national resources like rare earths and avoiding labeling criminal factions as terrorists. In contrast, left-leaning profiles highlighted Lula’s red-carpet reception at the White House and the focus on trade issues, such as export tariffs. Another major topic was the suspension by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the dosimetry law, sparking debate over authoritarianism, mainly among right-wing sectors.

item.title: Nunes Marques promove jantar por adesão com ingressos a R$ 800
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Nunes Marques will assume the presidency of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on November 12 and host a fundraising dinner with tickets priced at R$ 800. The event will take place at a venue in Asa Sul, Brasília, starting at 8:30 PM, and is by invitation only.

item.title: Senado aprova a renovação automática da CNH para bons motoristas
item.description: The Senate approved a provisional measure allowing automatic renewal of the National Driver's License (CNH) for drivers with no point-worthy traffic violations in the last 12 months, registered in the National Positive Driver Registry (RNPC). The proposal maintains physical, mental, and psychological aptitude exams but sets a single fixed price, updated annually by the IPCA. The text now awaits sanction by President Lula (PT).

item.title: Ao vivo: Nunes Marques toma posse como presidente do TSE
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques was sworn in as president of the TSE at 7 p.m. on Tuesday, May 12, 2026, in Brasília, assuming leadership of Brazil’s Electoral Justice ahead of the 2026 general elections. He had previously served as rapporteur for the electoral rules governing the 2026 vote, emphasizing stronger oversight of voting machines. The ceremony was attended by STF and TSE ministers and executive officials, with protocolary invitations extended to President Lula and former President Bolsonaro — the latter requiring authorization from Justice Alexandre de Moraes to attend.
